nom: Neutrogena Ultra Sheer Face Serum SPF 60+

avis.texte: I really love this sunscreen however I don't like it under make up. I live in a beach town so wearing sunscreen everyday I'm outside it's a must. This sunscreen is super light weight, when I reapply it at the beach it dries so quickly and it doesn't feel sticky on my skin. When I'm running errands around town or walking my dog it feels great on my skin and I never get red even with my fair skin. I have tried this under make up and it does pill which is unfortunate. I would recommend this if you are going to the beach or as an everyday sunscreen if you live in a high UV city/country and aren't going to wear make up that day.
I've been using the Ultra Sheer Face Serum SPF 60 for 3 years. Is my sunscreen, primer, and moisturizer all in one.

avis.titre: SPF that doesn't break me out
avis.texte: I break out over EVERY THING, but I trust neutrogena cleansers, so I tried this. LOVE IT for daily use — been using it for 3 weeks with no break outs.
It was clear, whiched i liked but it burned my face and eyes. Will not repurchase.

This is the least greasy formula I've tried, and there's no white cast. The serum-like consistency is easy to work with compared to thicker lotions. It plays well with my silicone-based primer and tinted serum too!

I waited to review this after i used it for a while. Im not sure why people are saying it burns their eyes, i have not had that experience at all, and i sweat a lot! Highly recommend to all who are looking for something moisturizing and lightweight. Doesnt feel thick or greasy!!! Will definitely be repurchasing

I really like this sunscreen because it is light and moisturizing, doesn't pill, feels comfortable on my skin, and I know it protects me from UV damage. However, I cannot put it anywhere above my lower eyeline. It always runs into my eyes even if I appy it above my eyebrows, so I must use a different non-running sunscreen around eyes and on forehead and temples. It leaves a shiney finish on my oily skin which I like. It would be perfect if it did not get in my eyes. I also must shake it vigorously each time because it separates after not being used for a month. I wish it did not run into my eyes. Maybe powdering would stop it if you like to use face powder.
I haave tried so many facial Sunscreens shd this is my go to! Great under makeup and my dry skin feels soft all day.

I wish I had read more comments before buying because they are all correct…this stuff will burn your eyes even when you do not put it anywhere near your eyes. AND hours upon hours after applying. Honestly, I am flabbergasted at why this is but it is. Do not buy.

avis.titre: Burned my eyes, but very good otherwise
avis.texte: I love this sunscreen if im careful about not applying too close to my eyes. It sits nicely on the face and doesnt look too oily. I use a light layer of pressed powder in my t zone on top of this to combat the oil and it works pretty well. Just be super careful around the eyes, ive never had such intense burning pain in my eyes as i did when some of this accidentally got on my eyelids

it says serum sunscreen which makes you think it would be thin but its lotion textured it feels great on the skin like velvet, but the eye burn is to bad even when I don't apply near my eyes it still burns so many others that don't burn for less money 5/10

avis.titre: Absolutely awful. Product is known for Adverse Eye Reaction.
avis.texte: I frequently use neutrogena products and almost exclusivly use thier sun protection products. However, when i tried this i had an AWFUL reaction. It had such an intense reaction with my eyes, they were hurting and red for over a week after using this product once. When a friend had the same reaction, i looked into it, and this product is known to cause this reaction. Do not purchace. I will continue to buy and use the other Neuterogena Sunscreens - just never this one.

avis.titre: It was good for a while
avis.texte: For the first couple weeks of using this product i enjoyed it thoroughly, other than the fact that it irritates eyes. I got around it by avoiding the eye contour area during application. As of late my skin has been reacting poorly to this product, my skin feels dry within a couple hours of application and I have developed a mild rash around my nose and lips (the most sensitive areas on my face). I really wanted to love it, but I will have to get rid of it.
Love the texture and it applies easy but somehow this always migrates to my eyes and burns.

I wanted something lightweight and quick to put on my face when I go out for errands. This is definitely light and easy but after 2 hours, my eyes start burning. At first I didn't know why my eyes started burning but after noticing the same pattern, it seems to be the sunscreen. I'm not sweating or touching my face. Price/value may not be worth it.

I bought this based on the reviews. I don't normally have sensitive skin, but this stuff burns! My entire face felt like it was being chemical burned. If you've ever used a chemical hair remover (like Nair) and it burned your skin & left a rash, that's what it felt like. Weirdly (and thankfully) I didn't get a rash or excessive redness, but it felt like I was, and it hurt. The irritation continued for many hours even after I washed it off. So yeah, I'll be returning this.
Do not buy! Terrible reaction in my eyes and caused headache. Even after washing off, it took several days to feel normal.

avis.titre: fine spf but burns my eyes
avis.texte: this is a fine spf. it doesn't let a white cast on me (but I am very pale). I just can't wear it because it runs into my eyes and burns no matter what I do
I want to love this, because mineral sunscreens tend to pill on me, and this absorbed so well. unfortunately it stung my eyes terribly. saving it for my body and hands
This product didn't fully absorb into my skin and ended up pilling. It also made my eyes water. I returned it.

Personally I love this spf, I use this everyday and it hasn't broken me out! I have dry, sensitive skin, but it doesn't irritate me at all. It does look slightly greasy on the skin, but I don't mind because I have pretty dry skin. I do recommend shaking the bottle first because it can separate.
I love the texture of this sunscreen but after an hour or so my eyes begin to sting. For this reason I will not repurchase.

I'd been using another of Neutrogena's sunscreens specifically for faces. This one includes just enough of a moisturizer that even the steamy heat of a coastal Virginia summer doesn't melt, feel greasy, or leave my skin feeling/looking dry. Buy it!

Really wanted to like this. I bought this thinking I was doing something good for myself. Every time I've tried this sunscreen it ends up in my eyes. It drifts down my forehead when I sweat and not only irritated my eyes but the lid and undereye area. DO NOT apply on or near the eye area.

avis.titre: I love this product but not the price!
avis.texte: I was thrilled to find a moisturizing serum with SPF 60. It's lightweight and perfect for our dry climate. It isn't the cheapest given its size. However, Ulta is charging much more than the competition for the same thing. Even with the buy one, get 50 percent off a second promotion, it's still more expensive than purchasing it elsewhere. That's the reason for my three star rating. The product is five star, Ulta's price is not.

This sunscreen is amazing if you don't have sensitive eyes. A few hours into my day, my eyes started burning and it got progressively worse to the point that I could barely see. Washing it off my face took forever and burned for hours after. Avoid if sensitive!!!

This is a very lightweight non greasy serum that has amazing sun protection that wears beautifully under makeup. I do find that if I get this directly into my eyes will cause burning and watery eyes. I just put this on the rest of my face and not on the eye lids. this doesn't have a white or gray cast on my medium skintone.
Used this for the first time. So worth it. It feels fresh when you put it on. It does work. I usually get real dark when I'm in the sun but with this I didn't even get a tiny tan haha.

I was hopeful about this one because I'm very fair and need sun protection. But it was a little shiny for me, and smelled like sunscreen. But by far the worst was it getting into my eyes within 1 hour and stinging all day.

This is the best moisturizer I have ever used. I'm 37 years old and love it. it's not greasy and doesn't cause breakouts even if I use it everyday. I was using various Clinique products but they weren't available for pickup at the store near me so I decided to give Neutrogena a try. So glad I did!

Very pleased with this soothing lotion. It's not greasy, sticky, and doesn't leave a white cast. I purposely used a good amount the first time, as I was just going outside to take a walk. Wonderful! It did not slime up as nearly every other lotion I've tried. Love the SPF 60, too. Get it!
I buy Neutrogena products including sunscreen. I like how this facial sunscreen with serum adds a gentle moisturizer to block UV.

This sunscreen is so so good. I have tried so many sunscreens and many of them have so much fragrance, feel super heavy on the skin, or cause me to breakout easily with small bumps around my face. This one does not at all it feels so nice to put it on my skin and does not pill! No white cast either. I will definitely buy this again once I run out.

avis.titre: So glad I decided to try it!
avis.texte: I've tried a couple of SPFs and I was using the Supergoop one before this and I was honestly tired of spending $40 on something that felt greasy so decided to try this and I honestly love it! It's super lightweight, fragrance freem hydrating and gives me an unbelievable glow plus great under makeup...will continue repurchasing.
love everything about this except for the insane stinging in the eyes. would recommend as body sunscreen or around perimeter of face
This stuff and gentle and smooth, works as a standalone moisturizer for daytime and thin enough to be worn under makeup. Make sure to apply a thin layer or it tends to pill.

Hands down my favorite sunscreen- it's light weight, fragrance free, and not super expensive. If you have really sensitive skin give this one a try, it did not burn or sting at all. It will give you a really nice glow so I think my girls with combination skin will love it.

The best face sunscreen I've used. Best decision buying it. It gives my skin such a glow, doesn't feel heavy or greasy, and rubs in very easily. I don't feel like there is any white cast and leaves my skin feeling so smooth. Highly recommend!!

I use this as my sun protection before I put on my makeup. I have never received more compliments on how glowy my skin is! This is by far my favorite sunscreen that I've tried. I will say that it does burn if it gets in the eyes, so be careful around the eye area.
I wanted to like this so bad but it made my eyes burn. Besides that it's beautiful on the skin

avis.titre: This is the most amazing sun product ever!!😳
avis.texte: Very simple product to use for screen protection.Very easy to include into your morning routine and to apply throughout the day if chosen. Lightweight and works well with makeup not heavy at all like most sunscreens! 10/10 for sure.
Smells like that typical sunscreen smell and I like the fact that for a face sunscreen it's high spf but it made my eyes run and burn 👎🏻
Doesn't leave a white cast on my brown skin✨. My skin is oily and I haven't had any issues with a greasy feel to my face. Nice one to try for those new to wearing spf daily

I bought this product hoping to find a US alternative to a JP product, but this did not make the cut. First, I avoid dimethicone in all skincare as I have oily skin and it seems to make it worse. My own mistake, I didn't realize this contains dimethicone. Second, and the biggest problem, I had a severe reaction to this product. A few hours after applying (tried it two separate times) my eyes became watering and swollen. This lasted for nearly 12 hours, even after washing my face. My partner also had the same problem. Neither of us were really outside sweating or swimming. I would say I have fairly sensitive, fair-ish skin, but I also am used to a sunscreen that contains alcohol and have little no allergies otherwise.

avis.titre: Made My Eyes Water & Burn All Day
avis.texte: When I first applied this sunscreen to clean skin with no serums I loved how matte it felt and the fact that there was no white cast left on my face however, I did start to notice that my eyes began watering and burning shortly after application. I thought perhaps it was a fluke and so I tried it again the next day, this time after applying serums and allowing ample time for them to dry. I was left with the same burning sensation & watery eyes all day. In addition to that uncomfortable feeling I noticed that it was coming off in small white chunks that got progressively worse during the day. I wanted to love this affordable product but as long as my eyes are burning, I am going to have to pass.

I have combination sensitive skin so sunscreen can always be a challenge. This is a great light weight product that doesn't sting my eyes, make me greasy, or pill. It was the perfect product for a humid and hot vacation.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: So far I have only used it a couple of times. I'll rate it after using it more.
It's clear, lightweight, not oil but has a dewy/ natural glow look, it doesn't break me out, AND it's sensitive skin friendly and doesn't irritate my eyes. Plus it's SPF 60!! Obsessed!!

I've owned this for a couple weeks and I really enjoy using it. It is very comfortable upon application. No scent and does feel hydrating because it is a serum. I've work it under makeup, just let it sit for about 10 mins and there is no pulling on me I completely agree with all the claims and will most definitely repurchase again. Do remember to shake it or the product will separate.

avis.titre: Wanted to love it but it pills
avis.texte: I wanted a product with a high spf. So I bought this one which has spf 60. However, although the texture is nice at first (serum softness), it pills even on its own. I threw it away after one use.
